تستقطبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْطِبُوا (tastaqṭibū) /tas.taq.tˤi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
# تُسْتَقْطَبُوا (tustaqṭabū) /tus.taq.tˤa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
